name: AutoTranslation
description: Translates the English text of your mods into the language you picked in Minecraft while you play: item names, tooltips, menus, FTB Quests and Patchouli books. It works with no setup (keyless Google Translate) and better with a free Gemini key. Translation happens when text is drawn; nothing in quest or book data is changed. Based on AutoTranslation by 墨涤千尘.
